targets.expected_type: ∀ {E : Type u} {ι : Type v} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] (s : Set E), Convex ℝ s → ∀ φ : ((ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ)) → ℝ, ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici (0 : (ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ))) φ → MonotoneOn φ (Set.Ici (0 : (ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ))) → ∀ p q : E → ι → ℝ, (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ s (fun x => p x i)) → (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ s (fun x => q x i)) → (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ p x) → (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ q x) → ConvexOn ℝ s (fun x => φ (p x, q x))

∀ {ι : Type u} (φ : ((ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ)) → ℝ), ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici (0 : (ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ))) φ → MonotoneOn φ (Set.Ici (0 : (ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ))) → ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : ι → ℝ => φ ((fun i => max (x i) 0), (fun i => max (-x i) 0)))
